result.summary: Liang Wenfeng's only public interview in 2023 was the 36Kr 暗涌 Q&A of May 2023. In it he made one dated AI forecast: by 2024 at the latest, big firms and startups alike would have their own large language models. He also said startups could enter 'at any point in the next 20 years', which I left out as a market forecast. He gave no AGI timeline that year; the well-known '2, 5 or 10 years, within our lifetime' remark comes from the July 2024 interview.

reply_text:
I found one dated AI prediction from Liang Wenfeng in 2023. It comes from his only interview that year, a question-and-answer with 36Kr's "暗涌 Waves" published on 23–24 May 2023.

- **The prediction:** He said that by 2024 at the latest, both big companies and startups would have built their own large language models. The Chinese original reads "最晚明年，大厂和创业公司都会把自己的大语言模型做出来". I read this sentence on both the Tencent and Sina reprints. The English version I read on LessWrong says "by next year at the latest, both big companies and startups will make their own LLMs."
- **Left out:** In the same answer he said startups could enter "at any point in the next 20 years" as the cost of building applications on large models falls. That is a prediction about the market rather than about what AI will do, so I didn't count it.
- **No AGI timeline in 2023:** His AGI remarks that year say where AGI might come from, not when it will arrive. The full Chinese text on Sina does not contain "有生之年" ("in our lifetime").
- **The 2024 quote people attribute to him:** "可能是2年、5年或者10年，总之会在我们有生之年实现" (AGI may come in 2, 5 or 10 years, but within our lifetime) belongs to the July 2024 interview. One search snippet says 暗涌 interviewed him in May 2023 and in July 2024, and that snippet contains the quote. I only saw it in snippets and did not open any page that carries it.
- **Pages to avoid:** The crossingriver Substack translation merges the 2023 and 2024 interviews without saying which answer comes from which, so it can't be used to date anything. The LessWrong and rentry.co copies are cut off partway through the 2023 interview.
- **Wasted call:** I accidentally ran the first fixed search twice because of a code error. It cost 7 of the 12 searches in all (6 distinct queries) and 5 of the 6 page openings.
